bugs.name: Long milestone titles overlap repository labels in the global milestone list at 390×844
bugs.summary: At a 390×844 viewport, a long milestone title overlaps its repository label in the global milestone list.
bugs.expected: Milestone titles and repository labels remain separately readable.
bugs.actual: The long title overlaps and obscures the eval/harbor-handbook repository label, including after filtering to Open and sorting by Name.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and create an open milestone named mo-milestones-small-viewport-390-20260614-1812-q3x in eval/harbor-handbook.
Set the viewport to 390×844 CSS pixels and open /milestones.
Select Open and sort by Name.
Inspect the long milestone row; its title overlaps the repository label and remains overlapped after waiting five seconds.

bugs.name: Global milestones: Sort > Name discards the repository filter and restores excluded milestones
bugs.summary: Sorting global milestones by Name clears the active repository selection and restores milestones from excluded repositories.
bugs.expected: Name sorting should reorder only milestones in the selected repositories, retaining the active repository selection and excluding milestones from deselected repositories.
bugs.actual: After deselecting eval/harbor-handbook, the global list shows 2 Open milestones. Sort > Name removes repos from the URL, resets the sidebar selection, and shows 3 Open including the previously excluded Handbook 1.1 milestone.
reproSteps: Sign in as fixture administrator eval. Through the UI, ensure at least two accessible repositories have open milestones; create disposable repositories/milestones if necessary.
Open the global /milestones dashboard. Deselect one repository in the sidebar and confirm its milestone disappears while another repository remains selected.
Open Sort and choose Name.
Observe that the repository selection resets, the URL loses repos, and the excluded milestone returns. In the native reproduction the count increased from 2 Open to 3 Open.

matchingGuidance.deduplication: Distinct from gitea-milestone-search-sort-reset (repository search drops sorting) and gitea-pass2-004 (rejected multiselect interpretation). This reference requires a verified excluded repository returning after global Name sorting.

bugs.name: Milestone search clears the selected due-date sort
bugs.summary: Searching milestones clears the selected Latest due date sort and shows the future-due milestone after the past-due milestone.
bugs.expected: After selecting Latest due date and searching QA, retain sort=furthestduedate and show the latest-due QA milestone before the past-due one, with undated milestones afterward.
bugs.actual: The search navigated to /eval/harbor-handbook/milestones?state=open&q=QA, dropping sort=furthestduedate. The visible filtered rows put undated QA Alpha first, QA Beta Past (Oct 1, 2026) before QA Gamma Future (Feb 28, 2027). This persisted in the reviewed recording.
reproSteps: Sign in as fixture user eval and open the repository Milestones page for eval/harbor-handbook. Through New Milestone, create three uniquely suffixed open milestones: QA Alpha Updated - QA-01 with no due date, QA Beta Past - QA-01 due 2026-10-01, and QA Gamma Future - QA-01 due 2027-02-28.

Open Sort and select Latest due date. Confirm that the URL contains sort=furthestduedate and that QA Gamma Future appears before QA Beta Past, with undated milestones afterward. This applies the sort before searching.
Enter QA in the milestone search field and press Enter.

Inspect the resulting URL and rows. The search URL contains state=open&q=QA but no sort parameter; undated QA Alpha rows appear first, and QA Beta Past appears before QA Gamma Future. Searching has reset the applied ordering.
bugs.sourceCause: Repository milestones use the shared issue search form, whose hidden sort input is inside the not PageIsMilestones condition. The milestone handler sets PageIsMilestones=true, so normal search submission sends state and q without the applied sort. The handler then passes an empty SortType to the milestone query, changing deadline_unix DESC to the default deadline_unix ASC, name ASC. This reverses dated rows and moves undated zero-deadline rows first.

bugs.name: Milestone due date January 1, 1970 renders as '-' despite being saved
bugs.summary: A saved January 1, 1970 milestone deadline displays a dash in the milestone list even though Edit retains the date.
bugs.expected: The milestone list should display the saved January 1, 1970 deadline as a date, consistently with other saved deadlines; it should not substitute a dash.
bugs.actual: The list shows a calendar icon followed by '-' for the milestone. Opening Edit shows the saved Due Date as 01/01/1970.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval in the fixture default UTC environment and open a writable repository’s Milestones > New Milestone.
Create a uniquely named milestone with Due Date January 1, 1970.
Inspect its row in the milestone list: the calendar icon is followed by '-' rather than the date.
Open Edit Milestone and confirm the saved Due Date remains January 1, 1970.

matchingGuidance.scope: Default UTC fixture display path. No lost date or identical behavior in every timezone is claimed.

bugs.name: Milestone All issues retains the implicit Assigned to you filter
bugs.summary: Returning the milestone Type filter from Assigned to you to All issues preserves an assignee restriction that the first selection injected, so previously visible open items remain hidden.
bugs.expected: Choosing All issues reverses the restriction introduced by Assigned to you and restores the milestone’s previously visible items when no independent Assignee filter was selected.
bugs.actual: At 390×844, the milestone initially displayed two open items, issue #4 and PR #5. Assigned to you showed no results. Selecting All issues still showed 0 Open, 0 Closed, and No results after five seconds; the URL contained type=all and assignee=1 despite no independent Assignee selection.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval. Create a disposable milestone and two open issues in a writable repository. Select that milestone in each issue’s Milestone picker, leaving both issues unassigned.
Set the viewport to 390×844 CSS pixels and open the milestone detail. With no independent Assignee filter selected, confirm both open items are visible.
Open the Type filter and choose Assigned to you. Confirm the unassigned items disappear.
In the same Type filter, choose All issues. Wait five seconds and observe that the items remain hidden and the URL includes type=all with an assignee parameter for the signed-in user.

bugs.name: Closing a milestone opens an empty closed-milestone list
bugs.summary: Closing the milestone redirects to a list URL with `state=close`; the page reports one closed milestone but renders no row until the Closed filter changes the URL to `state=closed`.
bugs.expected: After closing the milestone, the closed-milestone list should display the milestone consistently with its closed count, without requiring the user to select the Closed filter again.
bugs.actual: The close action landed at /eval/mo-gitea-03-issues-milestones-close-repro/milestones?state=close. The page showed “1 Closed” but no milestone row. Selecting “1 Closed” navigated to /eval/mo-gitea-03-issues-milestones-close-repro/milestones?state=closed and displayed the milestone row.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval.
Create a fresh repository named `mo-gitea-03-issues-milestones-close-repro` through the UI.
Open the repository’s Issues > Milestones page and create a milestone titled `mo-gitea-03-issues-close-repro-milestone`.
Open that milestone’s detail page and click its Close action.
On the resulting page at /eval/mo-gitea-03-issues-milestones-close-repro/milestones?state=close, observe “1 Closed” and no milestone row; the state remained visible after five seconds.
Click the visible “1 Closed” filter. At /eval/mo-gitea-03-issues-milestones-close-repro/milestones?state=closed, observe the milestone row.
